title: Carving Lanterns from Acorn Caps
description:
Lumen the snail lamplighter carves star windows into acorn caps, strings them on thread and lights them across Lantern Lane. Wordless miniature carving ASMR from Thimble Town.

snippets.LUMEN:
LUMEN — a snail lamplighter, glossy clay shell in honey-amber with a cream spiral, soft
sage-grey body, a tiny brass lantern hanging from a hook on the shell, a small navy peaked
cap. About 2.5 cm long. Unhurried. Lights every street lamp at dusk (the channel ident).
snippets.SET_LANE:
Lantern Lane: hand-built
miniature cobbled lane of cottages made from painted wooden-block cottages with teacup and tin-can roofs, iron lamp posts the height of a pencil stub with glass lamp heads the size of a pea, the brass sewing-thimble water tower at the far end (scale cue), painted wood, felt, paper and clay
micro-props, visible craft texture.
snippets.SCALE: SCALE LOCK: Lumen about 2.5 cm long; each real oak acorn cap about 1.5 cm across, a little smaller than Lumen's shell; the carving blade sewing-needle fine, about 1 cm; each candle stub a real birthday-candle stub about 8 mm tall that fits inside a cap; lamp posts pencil-stub high (about 3× Lumen's length); a real steel sewing pin lies on the cobbles in frame as the real-object scale cue.
snippets.LUMEN_TOOL: LUMEN TOOL LOCK (same convention as his lamplighting): Lumen has no hands, paws, arms or tentacles and holds nothing in his mouth; the brass lantern stays on its hook on his shell; the tiny carving blade sits in a small brass clip beside that hook, and he works by slowly leaning and gliding so the shell-mounted blade presses into the cap, exactly as he touches his lantern to a lamp.
